results.title: Data Architect
results.description:
We are seeking an experienced SQL Database Architect Administrator to lead the design, implementation, optimisation, security, and administration of enterprise database environments. This role combines strategic database architecture with hands-on database administration, ensuring that business-critical systems remain highly available, secure, scalable, and aligned with organisational objectives.

The successful candidate will be responsible for designing robust database solutions, managing SQL Server environments, supporting cloud and hybrid database platforms, implementing disaster recovery strategies, and driving database performance improvements. You will work closely with application development teams, infrastructure specialists, cybersecurity professionals, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable data solutions that support business growth and innovation.

This is an excellent opportunity for a database professional who thrives in complex environments and enjoys balancing architectural leadership with operational excellence.
  • Design and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performance SQL database architectures.
  • Administer and support Microsoft SQL Server environments across development, testing, and production platforms.
  • Develop database strategies, standards, policies, and best practices to ensure consistency and governance.
  • Monitor database performance and proactively identify opportunities for optimisation.
  • Implement and maintain database security controls, access management, encryption, and compliance requirements.
  • Design and manage high-availability and disaster recovery solutions, including backup, restore, clustering, and replication technologies.
  • Support cloud-based database services, including Microsoft Azure SQL and hybrid database architectures.
  • Collaborate with developers to design efficient database structures, queries, stored procedures, and indexing strategies.
  • Troubleshoot complex database issues and provide technical leadership during incident resolution.
  • Plan and execute database upgrades, migrations, patches, and platform enhancements.
  • Ensure data integrity, availability, and recoverability across all database systems.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and support knowledge bases.
  • Conduct capacity planning and forecasting to support future business requirements.
  • Provide technical mentoring and guidance to database administrators and development teams.
  • Participate in architecture reviews and contribute to technology roadmaps and strategic initiatives.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced expertise in Microsoft SQL Server administration and architecture.
  • Strong knowledge of database design principles, data modelling, normalisation, and performance tuning.
  • Experience with SQL Server Always On Availability Groups, Failover Clustering, Replication, and Log Shipping.
  • Proficiency in T-SQL, stored procedures, triggers, and query optimisation.
  • Experience managing Azure SQL Database, Azure Managed Instance, or other cloud database services.
  • Knowledge of ETL processes, data integration, and data warehousing concepts.
  • Familiarity with PowerShell scripting and database automation tools.
  • Experience with database monitoring and performance management platforms.
  • Understanding of backup, recovery, business continuity, and disaster recovery planning.

Knowledge

  • Database security frameworks, encryption technologies, and access control methodologies.
  • Data governance, regulatory compliance, and information security best practices.
  • Enterprise architecture principles and database lifecycle management.
  • Infrastructure concepts including Windows Server, networking, storage, and virtualisation technologies.
  • DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure-as-Code concepts.

Expertise & Experience

  • Proven experience in both database architecture and database administration roles.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage large-scale, mission-critical database environments.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting capabilities.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into effective technical database solutions.
  • Experience leading database projects, migrations, upgrades, and transformation initiatives.
  • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Azure Database Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent are advantageous.

This role is ideal for a senior database professional who can provide architectural leadership while ensuring the ongoing stability, security, and performance of enterprise SQL environments.

results.title: Head of DEI - UK
results.description:
We are seeking a passionate and strategic Head of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) to lead our UK DEI efforts. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and driving DEI initiatives that promote a diverse and inclusive workplace. You will work closely with leadership to ensure DEI goals align with business objectives, fostering an environment where all employees feel valued and included. If you're an experienced leader with a commitment to driving meaningful change, we want you to join our team.
In this role, you will drive DEI strategies across the UK, working closely with leadership to ensure initiatives are aligned with the company’s mission. You will lead the development and implementation of DEI programs, focusing on recruitment, retention, and inclusion efforts. Regularly measuring and reporting on DEI progress, you will foster an environment that promotes belonging for all employees. Additionally, you will advocate for DEI throughout the organization, providing guidance and support to ensure that diversity and inclusion are integrated into the company culture.

Strategic Leadership and DEI Integration
  • Lead the development and implementation of DEI strategies across the UK operations.
  • Ensure DEI initiatives align with the company’s overall business goals and culture.
  • Drive efforts to recruit and retain a diverse workforce through inclusive hiring practices.
DEI Training and Development
  • Design and implement DEI training programs for employees at all levels.
  • Facilitate workshops and discussions that promote inclusion and belonging in the workplace.
  • Monitor and measure the success of DEI programs and report progress to senior leadership.
  • Collaborate with department heads to integrate DEI best practices into all areas of the business.
  • Provide guidance and resources to employees and leaders on DEI-related matters.
Advocacy and External Partnerships
  • Champion DEI efforts across the company, advocating for diversity and inclusion at all levels.
  • Develop relationships with external organizations to support and promote diversity in the workplace.
We are looking for an experienced and passionate Head of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) to lead our DEI initiatives across the UK. In this role, you will drive the development and implementation of DEI strategies, fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. You will work closely with leadership to ensure DEI is integrated into the company's culture and business objectives, providing support, guidance, and leadership across the organization.

As the Head of DEI UK, you will lead efforts to improve diversity in hiring, retention, and promotion. You will oversee the creation of inclusive programs, training, and policies, while measuring the effectiveness of DEI initiatives. Your role will also involve working with internal and external stakeholders to ensure the company's commitment to diversity and inclusion is communicated effectively and consistently.

Essential
  • Extensive experience in leading and managing DEI programs in a corporate environment.
  • Strong knowledge of DEI best practices and UK-specific diversity legislation.
  • Proven ability to influence and engage senior leadership on DEI issues.
  • Experience developing and delivering DEI training and educational initiatives.
  • Demonstrated success in fostering an inclusive culture across large, diverse teams.
  • Degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, or a related field.
Desirable
  • Experience with diversity and inclusion metrics and tools for measuring impact.
  • Knowledge of best practices for diverse recruitment and talent development.
  • Experience in building partnerships with external organizations to promote DEI.
  • Relevant certifications in DEI, HR, or leadership development.
We offer a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package that includes health and dental coverage, pension contributions, and generous paid time off. You will have access to professional development opportunities, including DEI-focused training programs and leadership workshops. We value work-life balance and offer flexible working arrangements to support your personal and professional needs. In addition, we provide an inclusive and collaborative work environment where diversity is celebrated and everyone’s voice is heard.

results.title: Senior Software Engineer, GenAI Platform
results.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Software Engineer, GenAI Platform

About the Team

Deliveroo's GenAI Platform team sits within Machine Learning Platform and builds the shared infrastructure that helps DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo teams safely bring GenAI-powered products, agents, automation, and personalisation to production. Our mission is to increase the velocity of business impact from GenAI. A central pillar of that work is running frontier open-weight LLMs and VLMs (such as GLM, Qwen, Kimi, and DeepSeek) ourselves — real-time GPU serving, high-throughput batch inference, and fine-tuning on autoscaling GPUs — delivering large cost and latency wins (for example, a billion embeddings produced roughly 20× cheaper and visual models served roughly 72% cheaper). We also own core platform surfaces including the LLM Gateway, Agent Gateway, evals infrastructure, guardrails, and cost attribution.

About the Role

You will join a small, high-leverage team building production infrastructure for Generative AI at Deliveroo and DoorDash, leading the design and architecture of our open-weights model platform spanning inference and fine-tuning: real-time GPU serving, high-throughput batch inference, and model fine-tuning. You’ll set technical direction across model serving and inference engines, fine-tuning and training pipelines, GPU autoscaling and utilization, batch pipelines, backend services, and observability, and mentor engineers as you go. This role is ideal for a senior engineer who enjoys owning ambiguous, high-impact systems and pushing the cost/performance frontier of GPU inference and fine-tuning in a fast-moving technical area where product needs, model capabilities, vendor ecosystems, and cost/performance tradeoffs are evolving quickly.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Lead the design of infrastructure that helps teams move GenAI ideas from prototype to production, increasing the velocity of business impact from AI across the company.

  • Own and evolve our open-weights serving stack — real-time GPU endpoints, high-throughput batch inference, and fine-tuning (SFT/DPO/LoRA) — alongside the LLM Gateway, Agent Gateway, evals infrastructure, guardrails, and cost attribution.

  • Architect scalable, high-performance systems for model serving, batch inference, GPU autoscaling, and fine-tuning that power real customer and internal automation use cases

  • Push the cost and latency frontier of GPU inference — turning batch jobs that took days into hours and cutting inference cost by multiples — while giving product teams a clean choice across open-weight and closed-source models with reliability, fallback, observability, and cost controls built in.

  • Build platforms that support rapid experimentation while meeting production standards for latency, scale, monitoring, SLOs, playbooks, and operational excellence.

  • Partner closely with — and raise the technical bar for — ML engineers, product engineers, data scientists, and platform teams across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo to turn emerging GenAI capabilities into durable platform primitives.

  • Set technical direction for the future of the company's centralised GenAI platform — including emerging directions such as reinforcement learning (RLHF/RLVR), agent optimisation, and other post-training and agentic techniques — enabling the next generation of AI-powered products, agents, automation, and personalisation.

We’re excited about you because…

  • BSc, MSc or PhD in Computer Science or equivalent

  • 5+ years of industry experience in software engineering

  • Deep backend engineering fundamentals, especially in Python and distributed systems.

  • Track record of designing and owning production services, APIs, data pipelines, or ML infrastructure at scale.

  • Experience operating systems in production, including observability, debugging, reliability, incident response, and performance/cost optimization.

  • Deep hands-on experience with LLM inference and/or fine-tuning of open-weight models in production — serving (latency, throughput, batching, autoscaling, GPU utilization) and/or fine-tuning (SFT/DPO/LoRA).

  • Demonstrated technical leadership: leading design across ambiguous, fast-moving technical areas, mentoring engineers, and turning customer use cases into reusable platform capabilities

  • Proficiency in using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) in the full software development lifecycle, including designing, generating code, testing, monitoring and releasing software

Nice To Haves

  • Experience with LLM inference engines and serving frameworks (e.g., vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM) in production

  • Experience with distributed/multi-node fine-tuning and training pipelines (SFT, DPO/RLHF, LoRA), including data preparation and evaluation

  • GPU performance work — multi-node/distributed inference, KV-cache/memory optimisation, quantisation (FP8/INT8/AWQ/GPTQ), or cold-start/throughput tuning

  • Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), GPUs, serverless/elastic GPU platforms (e.g., Modal), or high-throughput batch systems

  • Experience with LLM gateways, model routing, vendor abstraction, or cost attribution

  • Experience building developer platforms, internal platforms, or self-serve infrastructure

  • Experience building and deploying AI agents or MCP servers in production

  • Experience with eval systems, LLM observability, tracing, RAG, search, or vector databases

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at .

results.title: Senior Data Engineer
results.description:
Netcompany is one of Europe’s leading technology partners, with more than 9,500 colleagues delivering digital solutions for governments, critical industries and businesses across Europe. We take responsibility for the full journey, from strategy and development to daily operations. As Europe’s leader in sovereign AI, we build technology on Europe’s own terms.

AI is a natural part of how we build solutions. We use it in business-critical systems through a proven delivery model where human judgement, transparency, security and accountability matter from design to daily operations. AI-related roles include roles clearly involving AI, machine learning, data science, generative AI, LLMs, AI automation, AI governance or AI architecture.

Job Description

Build the data foundations for a large-scale migration. You'll design and operate repeatable pipelines that move varied source data into a single platform, taking ownership of data processing from ingestion to delivery.

Key responsibilities

  • You'll work as part of a migration team, collaborating with the data lead, analysts, the platform team and source organisations throughout the delivery.
  • Build repeatable processes to receive, unpack, validate and ingest data from multiple sources.
  • Transform source extracts into consistent structures for migration to a single platform.
  • Develop maintainable ingestion and transformation code using SQL, Python, PySpark and dbt.
  • Implement automated checks that establish completeness and accuracy throughout the migration.
  • Monitor, diagnose and recover failed or incomplete data processing.
  • Maintain auditable records of data sources, mappings, transformations and outcomes, and apply agreed controls for secure data handling.

Qualifications

  • You bring hands-on experience building and operating data pipelines, with the technical skills to deliver reliable data processing in a structured migration environment.
  • Hands-on experience building and operating data pipelines on Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
  • Experience with Spark, PySpark, Databricks or comparable distributed processing technologies.
  • Experience building modular, tested and documented transformations using dbt or an equivalent approach.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills for writing and troubleshooting transformations, validation and reconciliation queries.
  • Experience scheduling, monitoring and recovering pipelines using cloud-native or equivalent orchestration tools.
  • Experience with Delta Lake, including transactional tables, schema changes and repeatable batch loading.
  • Experience using Terraform or equivalent infrastructure as code to provision and maintain consistent cloud environments.

Build on your experience and keep developing

Your development continues through the responsibility you take, the projects you lead and the people you learn from. As part of a structured career model, you’ll build on the experience you already bring, supported by a personal mentor from the leadership group who can help guide your professional development, career direction and personal goals.

Community is built through the way we work together. You’ll join teams where collaboration, trust and support are part of everyday work. We bring together colleagues with different backgrounds, identities, cultures and experiences, ensuring everyone is met with respect and has equal opportunities to develop and thrive.

Driven by responsible digitalisation

We believe digitalisation creates the most value when it is done responsibly. We build solutions that are secure, transparent, and designed to create lasting impact for people, businesses, and society. Responsibility is embedded in how we design, develop, and deliver every solution.

  • Professional certifications supported as part of learning and development.
  • A range of retail discounts to enhance your lifestyle, encompassing restaurants, supermarkets, travel, leisure activities and health and well-being services.

Company information

We pride ourselves on our entrepreneurial spirit and our capacity for doing things differently. Our culture is built on fostering low bureaucracy, emphasizing high agility and promoting flexibility, enabling everyone to contribute their best.

Motorola Solutions’ Avigilon Alta Video brings cloud video security systems to the next level. The Alta Video Engineering Team injects intelligence into our approach to safety and across every solution we engineer. Overview of the job

To implement and manage the strategic direction for Unpaid Work (UPW), ensuring that contract requirements are delivered efficiently and in compliance with specified standards and quality to support the overall objective to reduce reoffending.

This role will be regionally based reporting directly to the Head of Unpaid Work for their region. They will have direct line management responsibility for a mobile and dispersed team working across the region.

Occasional out of hours working will be required on an on-call duty rota to ensure that lone working staff have access to management support.
Summary
To ensure the requirements of the court are delivered through the assessment and planning of a diverse range of purposeful work placements, which meet health and safety requirements and ensure maximised accessibility that meets the diverse needs of people on probation.
To work in partnership with other agencies and local stakeholders to ensure the quality delivery and performance of unpaid work services meet contractual targets and the achievements of good outcomes for people on probation to enable them to make suitable reparation to their communities.

Overall management of the UPW team to achieve a high standard of service delivery, working efficiently whilst creating a safe working environment for staff and people on probation.
Responsibilities, Activities & Duties
The UPW Operations Manager may be required to undertake any combination, or all, of the duties and responsibilities set out below.
• To provide effective management and leadership to the team and be accountable for the quality delivery of good practice and team performance.

• To be accountable for the statutory link with risk management multi-agency forums.
• Work collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders to maximise awareness of Unpaid Work, for example with court report writers, sentencers and partnership agencies.
• Engage with a range of community partners including the office of the PCC, local authority forums and community safety partnerships to promote the service, negotiate partnership agreements and to generate opportunities for new placements benefiting the local communities.
• To provide management oversight regarding the suitability of offenders for community payback including the placement of high risk offenders and those with specific risk or other needs.
• To recruit and proactively manage staff development, performance, attendance management, employee relations and diversity matters in line with HR polices.
• Oversee the development and assessment of suitable projects and provide a leading role and direction in work with partners and key stakeholders, and represent the Probation Service as appropriate to the role.
• To be accountable for asset and fleet management and equipment, and ensuring the most efficient means of service delivery by aligning resources to demand in a cost effect way whilst achieving the organisation’s strategic aims.
• To work with the regional Health and Safety Advisor and Health and Safety Committee and union colleagues to ensure that working practices meet statutory requirements and to investigate any Health and Safety or Information Assurance breaches and introduce necessary improvements.

Job description

Proud to serve. Proud to keep justice going.

Our Operational Support Officers play a critical role, providing excellent customer service and administrative support to court and tribunal users, judiciary and management.

About us

HM Courts & Tribunals Service (HMCTS) is responsible for the administration of criminal, civil and family Courts and Tribunals in England and Wales. Our roles support our court users and colleagues within HMCTS, where people and businesses access potentially life-changing justice. We’re looking for individuals who are committed to public service and making a difference in people’s lives to deliver justice. If you are interested in developing a career with a real purpose, please apply.

Location

These posts will be based at Stafford Combined Court Centre, Victoria Square, Stafford, ST16 2QQ.

Positions available: 1 x Permanent and 1 x 12 month FTC.

Your role

Working as part of a team, you will contribute to the overall operational, performance and service standard targets across your area of work. You will progress cases through the court/tribunal system and provide customer service and administrative support to functions within HMCTS. You will have regular contact with court / tribunal users, which could include members of the judiciary and the legal profession.

You will be adaptable, able to multi-task and effectively carry out a variety of duties, both office-based and in a court, which will include:

  • Preparing papers and files for court, tribunals, hearings and meetings including processing and handling sensitive information and accurately resulting outcomes.
  • Creating and updating records digitally, interpreting information required on a court file accurately.
  • Communicating with the public, the judiciary, other court and tribunal users and representatives of other agencies and organisations
  • Supporting the smooth running of court proceedings, preparing court /hearing rooms and ensuring court runs efficiently.
  • When required, you will be an essential first point of contact for all the court users; meeting members of the public, which may include vulnerable witnesses, and their legal representatives.

Your knowledge, skills and experience

  • Strong customer service skills with the ability to work in a service-led customer-facing environment.
  • Good digital and administrative skills; with excellent attention to detail.
  • Effective communication and organisational skills. Able to communicate confidently in person, over the telephone, digitally and in written communications.
  • Resilient and empathetic to be able to deal with sensitive information and situations.
  • A team player; able to work collaboratively and flexibly to deliver HMCTS objectives.

Please refer to the role profile attachment for more information.

Further details:

These operational roles are customer facing, requiring successful applicants to be court based to provide HMCTS services to the public. Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week Monday to Friday. HMCTS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs and are agreed prior to appointment. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the MoJ’s Flexible Working policy.

Applications for part-time working will be considered however due to the nature of the role the minimum hours would be 30 hours per week over 4 days.

Fixed term appointments (FTA) on promotion MoJ employees may apply for FTA opportunities in MoJ that are advertised at a higher grade than their current substantive grade. Where an employee accepts an FTA on promotion, this promotion will be temporary, and the employee will revert to their substantive grade upon return to their home business area, as per the loan policy for OGD loans. Before applying, employees must seek approval from their line managers to ensure they can be released for the duration of the FTA and can return to their substantive role at the end. If there is no role available at the end of the FTA, the employee will be subject to redeployment and potentially redundancy procedures.

Prior agreement to be released on a loan or detached duty basis should be obtained before commencing the application process.

If you have held a Skilled Worker visa continuously, please raise this during your vetting checks and eligibility will be assessed in accordance with the immigration rules and transitional provisions in place.

If you are applying for this role and you have not held a Skilled Worker visa prior to the 22 July 2025 changes, you will need to consider your options for obtaining and/or maintaining your right to work in the UK in light of these changes. Successful applicants must ensure they have and maintain the legal right to live and work in the Civil Service and in the United Kingdom.

results.title: Business Analyst Graduate Programme
results.description:
• Deadline: November 28th, 2026
  • Salary: Competitive
  • Location: London (Hybrid)
  • Degree required: Bachelor's
  • Starting: September 2027
  • Disciplines: Business, Economics, Finance, Analytics, Maths

Please review all the graduate programme opportunities and make one application.

Our award-winning graduate programme provides the ideal springboard for an exciting and meaningful career in global financial markets.

Success graduates will join LSEG’s Markets division on the rotational programme and be part of a dynamic team that powers global financial markets and helps organisations navigate risk with confidence.

This graduate programme brings together our Capital Markets and Post Trade businesses to offer a comprehensive suite of solutions—from raising and trading capital across asset classes and geographies, to clearing and optimising portfolios, to managing regulatory, reputational and financial risk.

Whether it’s enabling companies to list and grow on the London Stock Exchange, supporting seamless post-trade operations, or delivering trusted data and tools like World-Check and identity verification services, you’ll be at the heart of the financial ecosystem. You’ll gain exposure to cutting-edge platforms like FXall and Tradeweb, work with clients across the globe, and help shape the future of financial markets.

This is a great opportunity for students studying a Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics subject or Finance, Economics with a strong inclination towards FinTech/Technology to apply their skills to Business related role. During the recruitment process we will get to know your skills and interest and how they align with the needs of the business to place you in your first rotation.

As a graduate you can expect exposure across:

  • Financial Risk teams, which involves monitoring and analysing risks, and interpreting data in readiness for the delivery of risk projects or reporting.
  • Or supporting our existing products! Contributing towards researching, tracking, and testing content and user interface of online products.
  • Or research analysis into global markets which could have a focus on debt listings, valuations, and shareholder and geographic analysis.

To be eligible you must be a graduate studying a Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics discipline, who has completed your studies in 2026 or a final year undergraduate or Master’s student and have completed all the requirements of your qualification before September 2027.

Highlights of the Graduate Programme

  • Progress through a 12-month development journey aiming to build foundational skills that are key for your future success
  • Build your foundational knowledge of LSEG, Financial Markets and the business during your global induction
  • Divisional-led inductions to immerse graduates into the business through team-led overviews and introductions
  • Participate in group projects which are aligned to LSEG goals
  • Meet in person with your cohort at ‘Ignite’, the programme mid-point skills offsite. Explore key knowledge areas and skills
  • Access opportunities to earn industry recognised qualifications, including 5 study days during programme
  • Connect with global early careers community and opportunities and contribute to wider society via CSR initiatives and volunteering opportunities

Our graduates join us on a permanent basis, and from day one you will be aligned to LSEG Markets, which will allow you to develop within a secure framework.

What we are looking for:

We are passionate about recruiting people who want to understand the full breadth of our organisation, how it fits together, how it functions – and are interested in playing a part of our development, as it grows and diversifies.

  • You should have a demonstrable interest in financial markets, which you’ve built through your studies, work experience or extracurricular activities.
  • A curiosity for data and an ability to analyse information to draw conclusions and propose solutions.
  • Individuals who are able to connect the dots and think strategically.
  • The environment we work in is fast paced, you’ll need to demonstrate focus, resilience and the flexibility to adapt to changing demands.
  • People who can collaborate with others, using their strong communication skills in the process.
  • Ideal candidates will have the rights to work in the UK without restrictions for the duration of the graduate programme and join us on a permanent basis.

You will stand out to us if you can demonstrate and recognise that what you achieve is equally important as how you achieve it.

Recruitment Process:

  • The first stage of the recruitment process involves making an application and submitting your resume.
  • The next stage of the application process is an untimed Immersive Online Assessment. The assessment is designed to give you an insight into what it’s like to work at LSEG.
  • The second stage is a video interview where you will answer a series of questions using a strength-based-interview style
  • The final stage is a half day assessment centre which involves several different types of exercises – further information is provided at the point of invite.

We recommend an early application as we consider candidates on a rolling basis. Due to the volume of applications, we might close the applications earlier, so we recommend an early application.

Please note, all our assessment centres are held virtually.

At LSEG, we provide our employees with a comprehensive benefits portfolio as part of a competitive total rewards package. Our benefit plans are designed to supplement the financial, emotional and physical wellbeing of our employees and their families at all stages of their life. We encourage an appreciative, collaborative and inclusive culture that promotes employee and organisational wellbeing.

We believe in remunerating our people with a variety of attractive benefits such as:

  • Emotional Wellbeing: Annual wellness allowance; Employee assistance programme
  • Physical Wellbeing: Private Medical Insurance; Optional dental Insurance; Gym membership & discounts
  • Financial Wellbeing: Life Insurance; Income protection; Pension
  • Other benefits: MyOffers: access to a range of retail discounts

We believe hybrid working makes more possible and recognise difference as a good thing. We want to set everyone up to bring their best self to work. Everyone will spend time with colleagues in the office (3 days), but you’ll be trusted to work flexibly, in a way that delivers excellence.

results.title: Data Architect
results.description:
We are seeking an experienced SQL Database Architect Administrator to lead the design, implementation, optimisation, security, and administration of enterprise database environments. This role combines strategic database architecture with hands-on database administration, ensuring that business-critical systems remain highly available, secure, scalable, and aligned with organisational objectives.

The successful candidate will be responsible for designing robust database solutions, managing SQL Server environments, supporting cloud and hybrid database platforms, implementing disaster recovery strategies, and driving database performance improvements. You will work closely with application development teams, infrastructure specialists, cybersecurity professionals, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable data solutions that support business growth and innovation.

This is an excellent opportunity for a database professional who thrives in complex environments and enjoys balancing architectural leadership with operational excellence.
  • Design and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performance SQL database architectures.
  • Administer and support Microsoft SQL Server environments across development, testing, and production platforms.
  • Develop database strategies, standards, policies, and best practices to ensure consistency and governance.
  • Monitor database performance and proactively identify opportunities for optimisation.
  • Implement and maintain database security controls, access management, encryption, and compliance requirements.
  • Design and manage high-availability and disaster recovery solutions, including backup, restore, clustering, and replication technologies.
  • Support cloud-based database services, including Microsoft Azure SQL and hybrid database architectures.
  • Collaborate with developers to design efficient database structures, queries, stored procedures, and indexing strategies.
  • Troubleshoot complex database issues and provide technical leadership during incident resolution.
  • Plan and execute database upgrades, migrations, patches, and platform enhancements.
  • Ensure data integrity, availability, and recoverability across all database systems.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and support knowledge bases.
  • Conduct capacity planning and forecasting to support future business requirements.
  • Provide technical mentoring and guidance to database administrators and development teams.
  • Participate in architecture reviews and contribute to technology roadmaps and strategic initiatives.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced expertise in Microsoft SQL Server administration and architecture.
  • Strong knowledge of database design principles, data modelling, normalisation, and performance tuning.
  • Experience with SQL Server Always On Availability Groups, Failover Clustering, Replication, and Log Shipping.
  • Proficiency in T-SQL, stored procedures, triggers, and query optimisation.
  • Experience managing Azure SQL Database, Azure Managed Instance, or other cloud database services.
  • Knowledge of ETL processes, data integration, and data warehousing concepts.
  • Familiarity with PowerShell scripting and database automation tools.
  • Experience with database monitoring and performance management platforms.
  • Understanding of backup, recovery, business continuity, and disaster recovery planning.

Knowledge

  • Database security frameworks, encryption technologies, and access control methodologies.
  • Data governance, regulatory compliance, and information security best practices.

results.title: Senior Software Engineer, GenAI Platform
results.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Software Engineer, GenAI Platform

About the Team

Deliveroo's GenAI Platform team sits within Machine Learning Platform and builds the shared infrastructure that helps DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo teams safely bring GenAI-powered products, agents, automation, and personalisation to production. Our mission is to increase the velocity of business impact from GenAI. A central pillar of that work is running frontier open-weight LLMs and VLMs (such as GLM, Qwen, Kimi, and DeepSeek) ourselves — real-time GPU serving, high-throughput batch inference, and fine-tuning on autoscaling GPUs — delivering large cost and latency wins (for example, a billion embeddings produced roughly 20× cheaper and visual models served roughly 72% cheaper). We also own core platform surfaces including the LLM Gateway, Agent Gateway, evals infrastructure, guardrails, and cost attribution.

About the Role

You will join a small, high-leverage team building production infrastructure for Generative AI at Deliveroo and DoorDash, leading the design and architecture of our open-weights model platform spanning inference and fine-tuning: real-time GPU serving, high-throughput batch inference, and model fine-tuning. You’ll set technical direction across model serving and inference engines, fine-tuning and training pipelines, GPU autoscaling and utilization, batch pipelines, backend services, and observability, and mentor engineers as you go. This role is ideal for a senior engineer who enjoys owning ambiguous, high-impact systems and pushing the cost/performance frontier of GPU inference and fine-tuning in a fast-moving technical area where product needs, model capabilities, vendor ecosystems, and cost/performance tradeoffs are evolving quickly.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Lead the design of infrastructure that helps teams move GenAI ideas from prototype to production, increasing the velocity of business impact from AI across the company.

  • Own and evolve our open-weights serving stack — real-time GPU endpoints, high-throughput batch inference, and fine-tuning (SFT/DPO/LoRA) — alongside the LLM Gateway, Agent Gateway, evals infrastructure, guardrails, and cost attribution.

  • Architect scalable, high-performance systems for model serving, batch inference, GPU autoscaling, and fine-tuning that power real customer and internal automation use cases

  • Push the cost and latency frontier of GPU inference — turning batch jobs that took days into hours and cutting inference cost by multiples — while giving product teams a clean choice across open-weight and closed-source models with reliability, fallback, observability, and cost controls built in.

  • Build platforms that support rapid experimentation while meeting production standards for latency, scale, monitoring, SLOs, playbooks, and operational excellence.

  • Partner closely with — and raise the technical bar for — ML engineers, product engineers, data scientists, and platform teams across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo to turn emerging GenAI capabilities into durable platform primitives.

  • Set technical direction for the future of the company's centralised GenAI platform — including emerging directions such as reinforcement learning (RLHF/RLVR), agent optimisation, and other post-training and agentic techniques — enabling the next generation of AI-powered products, agents, automation, and personalisation.

We’re excited about you because…

  • BSc, MSc or PhD in Computer Science or equivalent

  • 5+ years of industry experience in software engineering

  • Deep backend engineering fundamentals, especially in Python and distributed systems.

  • Track record of designing and owning production services, APIs, data pipelines, or ML infrastructure at scale.

  • Experience operating systems in production, including observability, debugging, reliability, incident response, and performance/cost optimization.

  • Deep hands-on experience with LLM inference and/or fine-tuning of open-weight models in production — serving (latency, throughput, batching, autoscaling, GPU utilization) and/or fine-tuning (SFT/DPO/LoRA).

  • Demonstrated technical leadership: leading design across ambiguous, fast-moving technical areas, mentoring engineers, and turning customer use cases into reusable platform capabilities

  • Proficiency in using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) in the full software development lifecycle, including designing, generating code, testing, monitoring and releasing software

Nice To Haves

  • Experience with LLM inference engines and serving frameworks (e.g., vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM) in production

  • Experience with distributed/multi-node fine-tuning and training pipelines (SFT, DPO/RLHF, LoRA), including data preparation and evaluation

  • GPU performance work — multi-node/distributed inference, KV-cache/memory optimisation, quantisation (FP8/INT8/AWQ/GPTQ), or cold-start/throughput tuning

  • Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), GPUs, serverless/elastic GPU platforms (e.g., Modal), or high-throughput batch systems

  • Experience with LLM gateways, model routing, vendor abstraction, or cost attribution

  • Experience building developer platforms, internal platforms, or self-serve infrastructure

  • Experience building and deploying AI agents or MCP servers in production

  • Experience with eval systems, LLM observability, tracing, RAG, search, or vector databases

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at .

  • Divisional-led inductions to immerse graduates into the business through team-led overviews and introductions
  • Participate in group projects which are aligned to LSEG goals
  • Meet in person with your cohort at ‘Ignite’, the programme mid-point skills offsite. Explore key knowledge areas and skills
  • Access opportunities to earn industry recognised qualifications, including 5 study days during programme
  • Connect with global early careers community and opportunities and contribute to wider society via CSR initiatives and volunteering opportunities

Our graduates join us on a permanent basis, and from day one you will be aligned to LSEG Markets, which will allow you to develop within a secure framework.

What we are looking for:

We are passionate about recruiting people who want to understand the full breadth of our organisation, how it fits together, how it functions – and are interested in playing a part of our development, as it grows and diversifies.

  • You should have a demonstrable interest in financial markets, which you’ve built through your studies, work experience or extracurricular activities.
  • A curiosity for data and an ability to analyse information to draw conclusions and propose solutions.
  • Individuals who are able to connect the dots and think strategically.
  • The environment we work in is fast paced, you’ll need to demonstrate focus, resilience and the flexibility to adapt to changing demands.
  • People who can collaborate with others, using their strong communication skills in the process.
  • Ideal candidates will have the rights to work in the UK without restrictions for the duration of the graduate programme and join us on a permanent basis.

You will stand out to us if you can demonstrate and recognise that what you achieve is equally important as how you achieve it.

Recruitment Process:

  • The first stage of the recruitment process involves making an application and submitting your resume.
  • The next stage of the application process is an untimed Immersive Online Assessment. The assessment is designed to give you an insight into what it’s like to work at LSEG.
  • The second stage is a video interview where you will answer a series of questions using a strength-based-interview style
  • The final stage is a half day assessment centre which involves several different types of exercises – further information is provided at the point of invite.

We recommend an early application as we consider candidates on a rolling basis. Due to the volume of applications, we might close the applications earlier, so we recommend an early application.

Please note, all our assessment centres are held virtually.

At LSEG, we provide our employees with a comprehensive benefits portfolio as part of a competitive total rewards package. Our benefit plans are designed to supplement the financial, emotional and physical wellbeing of our employees and their families at all stages of their life. We encourage an appreciative, collaborative and inclusive culture that promotes employee and organisational wellbeing.

We believe in remunerating our people with a variety of attractive benefits such as:

  • Emotional Wellbeing: Annual wellness allowance; Employee assistance programme
  • Physical Wellbeing: Private Medical Insurance; Optional dental Insurance; Gym membership & discounts
  • Financial Wellbeing: Life Insurance; Income protection; Pension
  • Other benefits: MyOffers: access to a range of retail discounts

We believe hybrid working makes more possible and recognise difference as a good thing. We want to set everyone up to bring their best self to work. Everyone will spend time with colleagues in the office (3 days), but you’ll be trusted to work flexibly, in a way that delivers excellence.

results.title: Data Architect
results.description:
We are seeking an experienced SQL Database Architect Administrator to lead the design, implementation, optimisation, security, and administration of enterprise database environments. This role combines strategic database architecture with hands-on database administration, ensuring that business-critical systems remain highly available, secure, scalable, and aligned with organisational objectives.

The successful candidate will be responsible for designing robust database solutions, managing SQL Server environments, supporting cloud and hybrid database platforms, implementing disaster recovery strategies, and driving database performance improvements. You will work closely with application development teams, infrastructure specialists, cybersecurity professionals, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable data solutions that support business growth and innovation.

This is an excellent opportunity for a database professional who thrives in complex environments and enjoys balancing architectural leadership with operational excellence.
  • Design and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performance SQL database architectures.
  • Administer and support Microsoft SQL Server environments across development, testing, and production platforms.
  • Develop database strategies, standards, policies, and best practices to ensure consistency and governance.
  • Monitor database performance and proactively identify opportunities for optimisation.
  • Implement and maintain database security controls, access management, encryption, and compliance requirements.
  • Design and manage high-availability and disaster recovery solutions, including backup, restore, clustering, and replication technologies.
  • Support cloud-based database services, including Microsoft Azure SQL and hybrid database architectures.
  • Collaborate with developers to design efficient database structures, queries, stored procedures, and indexing strategies.
  • Troubleshoot complex database issues and provide technical leadership during incident resolution.
  • Plan and execute database upgrades, migrations, patches, and platform enhancements.
  • Ensure data integrity, availability, and recoverability across all database systems.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and support knowledge bases.
  • Conduct capacity planning and forecasting to support future business requirements.
  • Provide technical mentoring and guidance to database administrators and development teams.
  • Participate in architecture reviews and contribute to technology roadmaps and strategic initiatives.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced expertise in Microsoft SQL Server administration and architecture.
  • Strong knowledge of database design principles, data modelling, normalisation, and performance tuning.
  • Experience with SQL Server Always On Availability Groups, Failover Clustering, Replication, and Log Shipping.
  • Proficiency in T-SQL, stored procedures, triggers, and query optimisation.
  • Experience managing Azure SQL Database, Azure Managed Instance, or other cloud database services.
  • Knowledge of ETL processes, data integration, and data warehousing concepts.
  • Familiarity with PowerShell scripting and database automation tools.
  • Experience with database monitoring and performance management platforms.
  • Understanding of backup, recovery, business continuity, and disaster recovery planning.

Knowledge

  • Database security frameworks, encryption technologies, and access control methodologies.
  • Data governance, regulatory compliance, and information security best practices.
  • Enterprise architecture principles and database lifecycle management.
  • Infrastructure concepts including Windows Server, networking, storage, and virtualisation technologies.
  • DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure-as-Code concepts.

Expertise & Experience

  • Proven experience in both database architecture and database administration roles.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage large-scale, mission-critical database environments.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting capabilities.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into effective technical database solutions.
  • Experience leading database projects, migrations, upgrades, and transformation initiatives.
  • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Azure Database Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent are advantageous.

This role is ideal for a senior database professional who can provide architectural leadership while ensuring the ongoing stability, security, and performance of enterprise SQL environments.

results.title: Head of DEI - UK
results.description:
We are seeking a passionate and strategic Head of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) to lead our UK DEI efforts. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and driving DEI initiatives that promote a diverse and inclusive workplace. You will work closely with leadership to ensure DEI goals align with business objectives, fostering an environment where all employees feel valued and included. If you're an experienced leader with a commitment to driving meaningful change, we want you to join our team.
In this role, you will drive DEI strategies across the UK, working closely with leadership to ensure initiatives are aligned with the company’s mission. You will lead the development and implementation of DEI programs, focusing on recruitment, retention, and inclusion efforts. Regularly measuring and reporting on DEI progress, you will foster an environment that promotes belonging for all employees. Additionally, you will advocate for DEI throughout the organization, providing guidance and support to ensure that diversity and inclusion are integrated into the company culture.

Strategic Leadership and DEI Integration
  • Lead the development and implementation of DEI strategies across the UK operations.
  • Ensure DEI initiatives align with the company’s overall business goals and culture.
  • Drive efforts to recruit and retain a diverse workforce through inclusive hiring practices.
DEI Training and Development
  • Design and implement DEI training programs for employees at all levels.
  • Facilitate workshops and discussions that promote inclusion and belonging in the workplace.
  • Monitor and measure the success of DEI programs and report progress to senior leadership.
  • Collaborate with department heads to integrate DEI best practices into all areas of the business.
  • Provide guidance and resources to employees and leaders on DEI-related matters.
Advocacy and External Partnerships
  • Champion DEI efforts across the company, advocating for diversity and inclusion at all levels.
  • Develop relationships with external organizations to support and promote diversity in the workplace.
We are looking for an experienced and passionate Head of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) to lead our DEI initiatives across the UK. In this role, you will drive the development and implementation of DEI strategies, fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. You will work closely with leadership to ensure DEI is integrated into the company's culture and business objectives, providing support, guidance, and leadership across the organization.

As the Head of DEI UK, you will lead efforts to improve diversity in hiring, retention, and promotion. You will oversee the creation of inclusive programs, training, and policies, while measuring the effectiveness of DEI initiatives. Your role will also involve working with internal and external stakeholders to ensure the company's commitment to diversity and inclusion is communicated effectively and consistently.

Essential
  • Extensive experience in leading and managing DEI programs in a corporate environment.
  • Strong knowledge of DEI best practices and UK-specific diversity legislation.
  • Proven ability to influence and engage senior leadership on DEI issues.
  • Experience developing and delivering DEI training and educational initiatives.
  • Demonstrated success in fostering an inclusive culture across large, diverse teams.
  • Degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, or a related field.
Desirable
  • Experience with diversity and inclusion metrics and tools for measuring impact.
  • Knowledge of best practices for diverse recruitment and talent development.
  • Experience in building partnerships with external organizations to promote DEI.
  • Relevant certifications in DEI, HR, or leadership development.
We offer a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package that includes health and dental coverage, pension contributions, and generous paid time off. You will have access to professional development opportunities, including DEI-focused training programs and leadership workshops. We value work-life balance and offer flexible working arrangements to support your personal and professional needs. In addition, we provide an inclusive and collaborative work environment where diversity is celebrated and everyone’s voice is heard.

results.title: Senior Software Engineer, GenAI Platform
results.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Software Engineer, GenAI Platform

About the Team

Deliveroo's GenAI Platform team sits within Machine Learning Platform and builds the shared infrastructure that helps DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo teams safely bring GenAI-powered products, agents, automation, and personalisation to production. Our mission is to increase the velocity of business impact from GenAI. A central pillar of that work is running frontier open-weight LLMs and VLMs (such as GLM, Qwen, Kimi, and DeepSeek) ourselves — real-time GPU serving, high-throughput batch inference, and fine-tuning on autoscaling GPUs — delivering large cost and latency wins (for example, a billion embeddings produced roughly 20× cheaper and visual models served roughly 72% cheaper). We also own core platform surfaces including the LLM Gateway, Agent Gateway, evals infrastructure, guardrails, and cost attribution.

About the Role

You will join a small, high-leverage team building production infrastructure for Generative AI at Deliveroo and DoorDash, leading the design and architecture of our open-weights model platform spanning inference and fine-tuning: real-time GPU serving, high-throughput batch inference, and model fine-tuning. You’ll set technical direction across model serving and inference engines, fine-tuning and training pipelines, GPU autoscaling and utilization, batch pipelines, backend services, and observability, and mentor engineers as you go. This role is ideal for a senior engineer who enjoys owning ambiguous, high-impact systems and pushing the cost/performance frontier of GPU inference and fine-tuning in a fast-moving technical area where product needs, model capabilities, vendor ecosystems, and cost/performance tradeoffs are evolving quickly.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Lead the design of infrastructure that helps teams move GenAI ideas from prototype to production, increasing the velocity of business impact from AI across the company.

  • Own and evolve our open-weights serving stack — real-time GPU endpoints, high-throughput batch inference, and fine-tuning (SFT/DPO/LoRA) — alongside the LLM Gateway, Agent Gateway, evals infrastructure, guardrails, and cost attribution.

  • Architect scalable, high-performance systems for model serving, batch inference, GPU autoscaling, and fine-tuning that power real customer and internal automation use cases

  • Push the cost and latency frontier of GPU inference — turning batch jobs that took days into hours and cutting inference cost by multiples — while giving product teams a clean choice across open-weight and closed-source models with reliability, fallback, observability, and cost controls built in.

  • Build platforms that support rapid experimentation while meeting production standards for latency, scale, monitoring, SLOs, playbooks, and operational excellence.

  • Partner closely with — and raise the technical bar for — ML engineers, product engineers, data scientists, and platform teams across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo to turn emerging GenAI capabilities into durable platform primitives.

  • Set technical direction for the future of the company's centralised GenAI platform — including emerging directions such as reinforcement learning (RLHF/RLVR), agent optimisation, and other post-training and agentic techniques — enabling the next generation of AI-powered products, agents, automation, and personalisation.

We’re excited about you because…

  • BSc, MSc or PhD in Computer Science or equivalent

  • 5+ years of industry experience in software engineering

  • Deep backend engineering fundamentals, especially in Python and distributed systems.

  • Track record of designing and owning production services, APIs, data pipelines, or ML infrastructure at scale.

  • Experience operating systems in production, including observability, debugging, reliability, incident response, and performance/cost optimization.

  • Deep hands-on experience with LLM inference and/or fine-tuning of open-weight models in production — serving (latency, throughput, batching, autoscaling, GPU utilization) and/or fine-tuning (SFT/DPO/LoRA).

  • Demonstrated technical leadership: leading design across ambiguous, fast-moving technical areas, mentoring engineers, and turning customer use cases into reusable platform capabilities

  • Proficiency in using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) in the full software development lifecycle, including designing, generating code, testing, monitoring and releasing software

Nice To Haves

  • Experience with LLM inference engines and serving frameworks (e.g., vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM) in production

  • Experience with distributed/multi-node fine-tuning and training pipelines (SFT, DPO/RLHF, LoRA), including data preparation and evaluation

  • GPU performance work — multi-node/distributed inference, KV-cache/memory optimisation, quantisation (FP8/INT8/AWQ/GPTQ), or cold-start/throughput tuning

  • Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), GPUs, serverless/elastic GPU platforms (e.g., Modal), or high-throughput batch systems

  • Experience with LLM gateways, model routing, vendor abstraction, or cost attribution

  • Experience building developer platforms, internal platforms, or self-serve infrastructure

  • Experience building and deploying AI agents or MCP servers in production

  • Experience with eval systems, LLM observability, tracing, RAG, search, or vector databases

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at .

results.title: Lead Operations Tech
results.description:
The Lead Operations Tech works hands-on alongside the Operations team while taking ownership of METRC and the administrative side of Operations. This role keeps compliance records accurate and in shared systems, supports the Operations Manager with day-to-day coordination, and helps train and guide Operations Techs, ensuring continuity, efficiency, and compliance with all regulatory and SOP requirements throughout the facility.

Tuesday - Saturday, 6:00 a.m. - 3:00 p.m. MST

OR

Tuesday - Saturday, 2:00 p.m. - 11:00 p.m. MST

Lead Responsibilities: METRC & Administrative Support

  • Own METRC entries for Operations, including package creation, transfers, adjustments, waste and reconciliation, keeping records accurate and audit ready.
  • Maintain Operations administrative records (batch sheets, manifests, inventory counts and logs) in shared systems so information is accessible to the whole team.

  • Perform dry trimming, de-boning, and strain-specific trimming techniques with speed and accuracy.
  • Maintain proper labeling, strain tracking, and batch organization to prevent mislabeling.
  • Serve as quality control on the trim floor, ensuring accuracy and productivity of 3rd-party trim crews.
  • Assist with cleaning, packaging, and HVAC/filter maintenance on non-harvest days.


Compliance, Safety & Facility Operations

  • Maintain warehouse compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and SOPs.
  • Follow all security procedures and ensure secure handling of plants and products.
  • Track plant waste and assist with regulatory compliance documentation.
  • Maintain cleanliness and organization throughout all facility areas (veg, bloom, prep, trim, dry, cure, exterior).

  • Answer phones with proper etiquette, assist with customer inquiries, and route messages to leadership as needed.

  • Perform administrative tasks such as filing, scanning, printing, shredding, and maintaining organized records.
  • Support storefront presentation through cleanliness, organization, and general housekeeping tasks.
  • Deliver exceptional customer service, creating a friendly and welcoming retail environment.
  • Assist leadership with product intake, restocking, barcode accuracy, and inventory rotation.
  • Communicate daily deals, specials, and expiring inventory to staff; report discrepancies immediately.
  • Support compliance by assisting Budtenders with transactions, checking in visitors, updating METRC records, uploading sales, and labeling new product.
  • Maintain accurate filing of manifests, invoices, patient files, and closing documents; complete all opening/closing duties per SOP.

  • Excellent time and task management skills
  • Packaging and/or manufacturing experience a plus

Summary The SBA Business Development Officer is a producing, revenue-generating role responsible for originating, structuring, and closing SBA 7(a) loans, SBA 504 loans, and other SBA and conventional commercial loans for small and mid-sized businesses throughout Locality Bank’s South Florida market. In addition to loan production, the officer brings in the full banking relationship, including commercial deposits and treasury management services, to increase the overall profitability of the Bank. The officer also serves as Locality Bank’s SBA subject-matter expert, partnering with the Commercial Banking team to identify SBA opportunities within the existing client base, and represents Locality Bank in the community through active participation in business, professional, and civic organizations.

Bank Culture

Locality Bank is a community bank with an innovative spirit. We empower local businesses to maximize their potential through personalized banking solutions, deep relationships, and forward-thinking financial technology. The bank’s culture blends inspiring innovative ideas, ownership, trust and authenticity with the warmth of a community bank. We believe a successful, local, banking relationship brings business success too.

Role Overview

This is an individual-contributor position reporting to the EVP / Chief Revenue Officer. The SBA Business Development Officer owns the SBA lending relationship from first contact through closing and funding, working side by side with the bank’s SBA Operations Team (processing, underwriting, and closing), the Credit Department, and CDC partners (for SBA 504 transactions). The role blends outbound business development with hands-on credit structuring, so the ideal candidate is equally comfortable calling on referral sources and business owners as they are analyzing financial statements and SBA eligibility. Locality Bank offers a collaborative, entrepreneurial environment where officers are encouraged to bring new ideas, take ownership of their results, and build long-term relationships in the community.


What Success Looks Like in This Role

  • Consistently generates a healthy, well-qualified pipeline of SBA 7(a) and 504 opportunities from referral sources, centers of influence, and the Bank’s Commercial Banking team.
  • a fast, clear, and professional experience for borrowers, from initial discovery call through closing and funding.
  • Structures sound, SBA-compliant loans that are approved efficiently and perform well over time.
  • Cross-sells deposit and treasury management solutions so that SBA borrowers become full-relationship clients of Locality Bank.
  • Becomes a recognized, trusted SBA resource within the Bank and across the South Florida business and professional community.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Business Development & Loan Origination

  • Proactively prospects, develops, and converts new SBA and commercial lending opportunities, including leads from Centers of Influence (CPAs, attorneys, business brokers, commercial real estate professionals, and other referral partners), secures appointments, and closes sales opportunities.
  • Works closely with the Commercial Banking team to source deals from internal partners, conducts regular training on SBA programs and SBA SOP requirements, joins commercial lenders on sales calls, and performs the follow-up necessary to secure strong SBA lending opportunities.
  • Develops a thorough understanding of the Bank’s SBA offerings, including the SBA 7(a) Loan, 7(a) Small Loan, International Trade Loan, CAPLines, and the SBA 504 Loan, and is able to explain program eligibility, terms, uses of proceeds, and guaranty fees to prospects and referral partners in plain language.
  • Interviews applicants to determine financing needs and gathers the information required for SBA loan applications.
  • Promotes the Bank’s deposit and treasury management products to SBA clients and prospects to establish full banking relationships.
  • Documents prospecting activity, pipeline status, and client interactions in the Bank’s CRM system and reports pipeline and production regularly to management.


Credit Analysis, Structuring & Underwriting

  • Analyzes each applicant’s financial condition, credit history, cash flow, collateral, and asset values to determine the feasibility of the request, and establishes an appropriate loan amount and credit limit through written and/or oral assessment.
  • Determines eligibility and the potential for an SBA guaranty in accordance with the current SBA SOP 50 10 (Lender and Development Company Loan Programs) and related SBA policy and procedural notices.
  • Structures loans within Locality Bank’s loan policy and SBA requirements, and champions loan opportunities to the Credit Department and/or Loan Committee for proper approval.
  • Resolves open questions on application information through follow-up with applicants, creditors, and other third parties.
  • Works in tandem with the Bank’s SBA Operations Team to process, underwrite, and close each SBA 7(a) loan.
  • Partners with the Bank’s CDC partners to process, underwrite, and close SBA 504 loans.


Closing, Portfolio & Relationship Management

  • Prepares and presents the financing proposal and term sheet to the applicant consistent with credit approval.
  • Reviews loan documentation prior to closing for completeness and acceptance by the applicant, and ensures timely loan closing and funding.
  • Maintains positive, active working relationships with customers, Bank staff, local professionals, and Centers of Influence to expand the customer base and build long-term relationships.
  • Assists in managing the loan portfolio, including renewals, modifications, updated credit analysis, collections, and portfolio monitoring.
  • Studies and evaluates new markets, programs, policies, and services related to business development, and recommends new products based on identifiable customer needs.
  • Community Engagement, Compliance & Other Duties
  • Participates in networking events and in community and professional organizations where membership or involvement will enhance the profitable growth of the Bank and its visibility in the market.
  • Works closely with the Bank’s Advisory Boards to provide products and services to the community.
  • Attends management and staff meetings, as well as sales, pipeline, and credit meetings as required.
  • Assures compliance with established Bank policies and procedures and with SBA requirements.
  • Complies with regulatory requirements and Bank policies and procedures for BSA/AML/CFT compliance.
  • Uses experience and sound judgment to plan and accomplish goals.
  • Performs all other duties and responsibilities as assigned.


Key Performance Measures

  • Annual SBA loan production (number and dollar volume of SBA 7(a) and 504 loans closed), measured against goals set annually with the EVP / Chief Revenue Officer.
  • Quality and size of the SBA pipeline, including new opportunities sourced and conversion rates.
  • Commercial deposit and treasury management relationships generated from SBA clients.
  • Loan credit quality, documentation accuracy, and compliance with Bank policy and SBA requirements.
  • Referral partner development, internal training provided, and community involvement.


Education and Qualifications Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Finance, or a related area preferred
  • Minimum five years’ experience in small business lending, with experience in marketing, sales, finance, or a related field
  • Demonstrated experience originating and structuring SBA 7(a) loans; SBA 504 experience preferred
  • Training in SBA lending and the SBA SOP 50 10 requirements
  • Proven record of business development and loan production, with an established network of referral sources in South Florida preferred
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation for local business travel

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Knowledge of the banking industry, including business development, sales, and marketing
  • Working knowledge of SBA 7(a) and 504 program requirements, eligibility, and SBA SOP 50 10, and of the Bank’s products and services
  • Knowledge of local, state, and federal regulations governing the banking industry
  • Skill in prospecting, networking, and consultative selling
  • Skill in financial statement, tax return, cash flow, and collateral analysis
  • Skill in communicating with employees, customers, and referral partners
  • Ability to exercise good judgment in establishing and maintaining working relationships
  • Ability to handle stressful situations, solve problems, and deliver a high level of accuracy, focus, and timeliness with limited supervision
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality
  • Ability to work in an organized manner and manage multiple deals and deadlines simultaneously
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret policies, contracts, credit and financial documents, and other legal documents as needed
  • Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with employees, customers, the Board of Directors, and the public


Competencies

  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and other financial software; comfortable using a CRM to manage pipeline and client activity
  • Understands the capabilities of the Bank’s core software applications and Information Technology protocols
  • Relationship builder with a strong sales drive, self-motivation, and a sense of ownership for results
  • Sound credit judgment, attention to detail, and the integrity to uphold Bank and SBA compliance standards
  • Collaborative team player who partners well with lenders, underwriters, operations, and credit staff
